The very first light of the world: a brilliant warm golden light bursting out of deep dark swirling clouds above an empty dark ocean, glowing rays spreading in every direction. No people, no animals, no plants.
caption: ביום הראשון ה' ברא את האור

en: Pristine untouched wild nature at the very beginning of the world, completely empty of people, animals, houses, buildings, roads or paths: green trees full of red apples, oranges and pomegranates, colorful flowers blooming everywhere, soft green grass and a clear river, bright morning sky.
caption: ה' הצמיח עצים, פרחים ופרות

en: Pristine untouched wild nature with no houses, no buildings, no people: many animals together in a green meadow by a pond: a lion, an elephant, a giraffe, a deer, rabbits, colorful birds flying in the sky, fish jumping out of the blue pond. No people.
caption: ה' ברא דגים, צפורים וחיות

en: The first man, a gentle young man with a short dark beard wearing a simple long beige robe, standing in a beautiful garden full of fruit trees, looking up at the sky with wonder and gratitude, his hands open. A few friendly animals nearby.
caption: ה' ברא את האדם

en: A festive Shabbat table at evening: two lit candles in silver candlesticks, two braided challah breads under an embroidered cloth cover, a silver wine cup, white tablecloth, warm peaceful golden glow, a window showing the first stars. No people.
caption: ביום השביעי ה' שבת וברך את השבת

en: A young shepherd in a simple brown robe joyfully carrying the most beautiful fluffy white lamb in his arms toward a small stone altar in a green field, sunny sky, other sheep grazing behind him.
caption: הבל הביא לה' את הכבש היפה ביותר

en: Noah, a kind righteous old man with a white beard, standing calmly with his hands raised in prayer toward the sky on a hill, while in the valley below rough men are quarreling and grabbing things from each other.
caption: נח היה צדיק והלך בדרכי ה'

en: Noah, an old man with a white beard, hammering wooden planks to build a huge wooden ark on dry land, his three adult sons helping him carry beams, piles of wood and tools around.
caption: נח בנה את התבה כמו שה' צוה

en: Animals walking in pairs up a wooden ramp into a big wooden ark: two elephants, two giraffes, two lions, two zebras, two sheep, birds flying in pairs, Noah with white beard standing at the door welcoming them.
caption: החיות נכנסו לתבה שתים שתים

en: Inside the cozy wooden ark lit by oil lamps, old Noah with a white beard lovingly feeding the animals from a basket: a lion, giraffes, sheep, birds on beams, an elephant eating hay.
caption: נח האכיל את כל החיות בתבה

en: A white dove flying toward the wooden ark resting on a mountain, holding a green olive leaf in its beak, the flood water going down, old Noah with white beard leaning out of the window happily reaching out his hands.
caption: היונה חזרה עם עלה זית

en: Old Noah with a white beard and his sons standing beside a simple stone altar with a small fire on green land after the flood, a big beautiful bright rainbow across the sky above them, animals walking out of the ark in the background.
caption: נח הקריב קרבן לה', ובענן קשת

en: Avram, a dignified man with a dark grey beard, leading a long caravan of camels, donkeys and sheep out of a city gate onto a desert road toward distant hills, walking with determination and faith, looking forward.
caption: ה' אמר לאברם: לך לך, ואברם יצא לדרך

en: Avram, a man with a dark grey beard, building a simple altar of piled stones on a green hill in the land of Canaan, kneeling in prayer next to it, hills and olive trees around, morning light.
caption: אברם בנה מזבח לה' בארץ כנען

en: Avram and his nephew Lot, a younger bearded man, standing on a hill and shaking hands warmly, Avram pointing with an open hand toward a green fertile valley, their two separate flocks of sheep below.
caption: אברם ולוט נפרדו בשלום

en: Avram with a dark grey beard leading a small band of brave servants with torches at night, rescuing his nephew Lot who is running toward him with open arms, tents in the background. No blood, no violence shown.
caption: אברם הציל את לוט מן המלחמה

en: Avram with a dark grey beard politely refusing with his raised palm a richly dressed king who offers him a big heap of gold, treasures and fancy clothes; Avram shakes his head no, kindly.
caption: אברם לא לקח כלום ממלך סדום

en: Avram with a dark grey beard standing outside his tent at night, looking up in wonder at a sky absolutely full of countless bright stars, his arm pointing up at the stars.
caption: ה' הראה לאברם את הכוכבים

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, sitting at the open entrance of his large tent on a very hot sunny day, shading his eyes with his hand and looking far out at the empty desert road, waiting for guests.
caption: אברהם ישב בפתח האהל וחכה לאורחים

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, running eagerly with open welcoming arms toward three travelers with walking sticks and dusty robes approaching on the desert road, his tent behind him.
caption: אברהם רץ לקראת שלושה אורחים

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, happily serving three seated travelers a meal under a big shady tree: bread, a bowl of butter, a jug of milk and a plate of meat, a water basin for washing their feet nearby.
caption: אברהם הגיש לאורחים אכל טעים

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, standing on a hilltop praying with his hands raised, looking down at a distant walled city in the valley under dark clouds.
caption: אברהם התפלל על אנשי סדום

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, joyfully holding a tiny newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket at a happy celebration, bearded men around him smiling and clapping, a festive table.
caption: אברהם מל את יצחק בן שמונה ימים

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, and his son Yitzchak, a boy of about twelve carrying a bundle of sticks on his back, walking side by side up a mountain path together, holding hands, early morning light.
caption: אברהם ויצחק הלכו יחדו אל ההר

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, paying shiny silver coins weighed on a scale to a merchant at the entrance of a cave in a rocky hillside, several elders of the city watching and nodding, the land of Hebron with olive trees.
caption: אברהם קנה את מערת המכפלה

en: Avraham, an old man with a long white beard, sending off his loyal servant Eliezer, a middle-aged bearded man, who stands beside ten camels loaded with gifts and treasures, Avraham blessing him with a hand on his shoulder.
caption: אברהם שלח את אליעזר למצא כלה ליצחק

en: Eliezer, a middle-aged bearded man, standing beside a stone water well at sunset with ten kneeling camels, his hands raised in prayer, looking up at the sky.
caption: אליעזר התפלל לה' ליד הבאר

en: A little girl who looks about four years old, in a full loose long-sleeved dress down to her ankles (nothing tight, nothing exposed), pouring water from a clay jug into a long stone trough while many thirsty camels drink, Eliezer, a bearded man, watching her with amazement beside the well.
caption: רבקה השקתה את אליעזר ואת הגמלים

en: A caravan of camels leaving a town at dawn, Eliezer, a bearded man, leading the first camel by its rope, a small girl who looks about four years old, in a full loose long-sleeved dress down to her ankles (nothing tight, nothing exposed) sitting safely on the camel, waving goodbye.
caption: רבקה יצאה עם אליעזר אל יצחק

en: Yitzchak, a young man with a short beard, alone in a wide green field at sunset, praying with deep concentration, a few olive trees, golden evening sky.
caption: יצחק יצא לשדה להתפלל

en: Yitzchak, a man with a short dark beard, standing alone in a corner of his tent, praying with great feeling, his hands covering his eyes, a soft beam of light coming in.
caption: יצחק התפלל לה' שיהיו לו ילדים

en: Two different boys about twelve: on one side a gentle boy sitting inside a tent learning from a scroll by an oil lamp, and on the other side outside a wild red-haired boy with a bow and arrows running off to hunt in the field.
caption: יעקב ישב באהל ולמד תורה

en: A tired red-haired young hunter with a bow on his back eagerly reaching for a steaming bowl of red lentil stew that a gentle young man with a short beard is offering him inside a tent, a pot on the fire.
caption: עשו מכר ליעקב את הבכורה

en: Yitzchak, a man with a dark beard, standing proudly in a huge golden field of tall wheat, harvesting with a sickle, enormous overflowing piles of grain sacks around him, bright sun.
caption: יצחק זרע, וה' ברך את השדה

en: Yitzchak, a man with a dark beard, and his servants digging a deep well with shovels in the dry desert, fresh water bubbling up from the ground, his servants cheering.
caption: יצחק חפר בארות מים

en: An elderly blind man with a white beard sitting on a bed placing his hand in blessing on the head of a kneeling young man with a short beard wearing a fur on his arms, a bowl of food on a small table.
caption: יצחק ברך את יעקב

en: Yaakov, a young man with a short dark beard, sleeping on the ground at night with his head resting on stones, and above him a huge glowing golden ladder rising from the ground up into the starry sky and the clouds. Nobody on the ladder.
caption: יעקב חלם על סלם שמגיע לשמים

en: Yaakov, a young man with a short dark beard, at sunrise pouring oil from a small jug onto the top of a tall standing stone pillar, kneeling with a happy grateful face.
caption: יעקב הקים מצבה והבטיח לתת מעשר

en: Yaakov, a strong young man with a short dark beard, rolling a very large heavy round stone off the mouth of a well all by himself, flocks of sheep waiting to drink, shepherds amazed.
caption: יעקב גלגל את האבן מעל הבאר

en: Yaakov, a young man with a short dark beard, wrapped in a cloak guarding a flock of sheep at night under a cold starry sky, holding a shepherd's staff, frost on the ground, a small lamb in his arms.
caption: יעקב שמר על הצאן ביום ובלילה

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, sitting happily in front of his tent surrounded by many small boys of different ages playing and hugging him, a big happy family.
caption: נולדו ליעקב בנים – השבטים

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, leading a long caravan of camels, sheep, goats and his many young sons on a road through hills toward a beautiful green land, sunrise.
caption: יעקב חזר לארץ ישראל

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, standing alone in his tent at night, praying with his hands raised and eyes closed, deeply concentrated, an oil lamp glowing.
caption: יעקב התפלל לה' שיציל אותו

en: Servants leading big flocks of goats, sheep, camels, cows and donkeys in separate groups along a road as gifts, Yaakov with a dark beard watching from a hill and pointing the way.
caption: יעקב שלח לעשו מתנות

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, alone at night by a stream, carefully picking up a few small clay jugs he forgot and holding them in his arms, moonlight.
caption: יעקב חזר לבד להביא כדים קטנים

en: Two bearded brothers hugging warmly in an open field: Yaakov with a dark beard and Esav with a red beard, behind Esav a group of men, behind Yaakov flocks of sheep.
caption: יעקב ועשו נפגשו

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, burying small stone idols in a hole under a big oak tree with a shovel, his sons watching.
caption: יעקב טמן את הפסלים מתחת לעץ

en: Yaakov, a man with a dark beard, building an altar of stones on a hill and praying beside it, his sons helping carry stones, golden light.
caption: יעקב בנה מזבח לה' בבית אל

en: Yaakov, an old man with a grey beard, lovingly giving his son Yosef, a happy boy about seventeen, a beautiful coat with colorful stripes, Yosef putting it on, brothers in the background looking jealous.
caption: יעקב נתן ליוסף כתנת פסים

en: Yosef, a teenage boy in a colorful striped coat, telling his dream to his brothers in the field, above him a dream bubble shows sheaves of wheat bowing to one standing sheaf, the brothers frowning.
caption: יוסף ספר לאחים את החלומות

en: Yosef, a teenage boy in a colorful striped coat, saying goodbye to his old father with a grey beard at the door of the tent, then setting off walking on a long road toward distant fields with a walking stick.
caption: יוסף אמר לאבא: הנני, והלך אל אחיו

en: Yosef, a teenage boy without a coat, being led away with a merchant caravan of camels carrying large sacks of fragrant spices, flowers and perfumes, his sad face, desert road.
caption: יוסף נמכר לשירה של בשמים

en: Yosef, a young man in a fine white Egyptian robe, working successfully in a rich Egyptian house, holding a list of things and organizing servants, everything growing and blooming around him, full storerooms.
caption: ה' היה עם יוסף, והכל הצליח לו

en: Yosef, a young man in a plain robe inside a stone prison, explaining dreams to two worried prisoners: one in a cup-bearer outfit, one in a baker outfit with a basket, small dream bubbles above them showing grapes and bread baskets.
caption: יוסף פתר חלומות בבית הסהר

en: Pharaoh, an Egyptian king with a crown, sleeping on a golden bed, above him a dream bubble showing seven fat cows and seven thin cows coming out of the river Nile and ears of grain.
caption: פרעה חלם על פרות ועל שבלים

en: Yosef, a young man with a short beard in a white robe, standing before Pharaoh on his throne in the palace, pointing up to the sky humbly while explaining, Egyptian servants around.
caption: יוסף אמר לפרעה: ה' יפתר את החלום

en: Yosef, in fine Egyptian clothes with a gold chain, supervising workers who carry heavy sacks of grain into huge storehouses full of grain piles, Egyptian pyramids in the distance.
caption: יוסף אסף תבואה במחסנים

en: Ten bearded brothers in Canaanite robes with donkeys bowing low before an Egyptian ruler (a young man with a short beard) on a high chair in a hall, sacks of grain around. Only men in the picture: the guards beside the chair are bearded men with spears. No paintings of people on the walls.
caption: האחים ירדו למצרים לקנות אכל

en: Yaakov, an old man with a white beard, hugging his youngest son Binyamin, a young man, goodbye, the older brothers waiting with donkeys loaded with gifts and sacks.
caption: יעקב שלח את בנימין עם האחים

en: An Egyptian steward pulling a shiny silver goblet out of a grain sack on a donkey, the brothers shocked, the youngest brother looking surprised.
caption: הגביע נמצא באמתחת של בנימין

en: Yehuda, a strong bearded man, stepping forward bravely to speak to the Egyptian ruler Yosef on his chair, putting a protective hand on the shoulder of his young brother Binyamin behind him.
caption: יהודה נגש אל יוסף להציל את בנימין

en: Yosef, an Egyptian ruler in fine clothes, crying with joy and opening his arms wide to his brothers in a palace hall, the brothers amazed, one brother hugging him.
caption: יוסף אמר: אני יוסף!

en: A line of Egyptian wagons pulled by oxen and donkeys, loaded with gifts, food and treasures, traveling across the desert toward the land of Canaan.
caption: יוסף שלח עגלות לאבא

en: Yehuda, a bearded man, arriving at a green land and setting up a simple house of study: men carrying scrolls and wooden benches into a stone building, Yehuda directing them.
caption: יהודה הלך לפניהם להכין בית מדרש

en: Old Yaakov with a white beard meeting his son Yosef in Egyptian clothes, Yosef hugging him with tears of joy, while Yaakov has his eyes closed and his hand covering his eyes as he says a prayer, a chariot behind.
caption: יעקב פגש את יוסף וקרא קריאת שמע

en: Old Yaakov with a long white beard standing before Pharaoh in his palace, raising his hand in blessing, Pharaoh bowing his head respectfully.
caption: יעקב ברך את פרעה

en: Old Yaakov with a long white beard lying in bed, holding the hand of his son Yosef in Egyptian ruler clothes, Yosef kneeling and promising with a serious face, a window showing the far away hills.
caption: יעקב בקש מיוסף לקברו בארץ ישראל

en: Old Yaakov with a long white beard sitting on his bed, blessing two boys standing before him, with his arms crossed so his right hand is on the head of the younger boy on the left side, Yosef watching.
caption: יעקב ברך את אפרים ומנשה

en: Many bearded grown-up brothers gathered around the bed of their old father with a long white beard, all of them with their right hand covering their eyes in prayer together, the father smiling peacefully.
caption: הבנים אמרו ליעקב: שמע ישראל

en: Many bearded brothers carrying a wooden coffin with a golden crown on top on their shoulders, walking in a respectful procession toward a cave in rocky hills in the land of Canaan, Egyptian chariots behind.
caption: הבנים נשאו את יעקב למערת המכפלה

en: Yosef, an Egyptian ruler with a short beard, kindly comforting his worried brothers, putting a gentle hand on a brother's shoulder and smiling, the brothers relieved.
caption: יוסף נחם את אחיו ודבר אליהם טוב

en: Yosef, an old man with a white beard in Egyptian clothes, sitting with many children and grandchildren around him, pointing toward the far away land of Israel with green hills and a rising sun, everyone looking hopeful.
caption: יוסף אמר: ה' יגאל אתכם

en: Hebrew slaves in ancient Egypt, bearded men in simple worn robes, working hard under a hot sun: carrying heavy clay bricks on their backs and building tall brick walls, a pyramid far away, an Egyptian overseer in a white kilt pointing. Only men in the picture, no paintings of people on the walls. Gentle, not scary.
caption: בני ישראל עבדו עבודה קשה במצרים

en: A tiny little girl who looks about three years old, with a small round child face, in a full loose long-sleeved dress down to her ankles and a head scarf (nothing tight, nothing exposed), hiding among tall green reeds on the bank of the Nile river, watching carefully over a small woven reed basket floating on the water, a baby wrapped in a blanket sleeping inside the basket. Nobody else in the pic
caption: מרים שמרה על התבה של משה ביאר

en: Moshe, a tall young shepherd with a dark brown beard and a wooden staff, gently carrying a tiny tired baby goat on his shoulders in the desert, a small water spring nearby, his flock of sheep and goats behind him, warm loving face.
caption: משה הרועה רחם על גדי קטן

en: Moshe, a tall shepherd with a dark brown beard holding a wooden staff, standing barefoot with his sandals on the ground beside him, covering his eyes in awe in front of a thorny desert bush that is burning with bright golden flames while its green leaves stay whole and unburned, sheep in the background, desert mountain. Nothing in the fire except flames.
caption: ה' דבר אל משה מתוך הסנה הבוער

en: Two bearded men with walking staffs, Moshe, tall with a dark brown beard, and his older brother Aharon with a grey beard, standing bravely in a grand Egyptian palace hall with tall painted columns before Pharaoh, an Egyptian king in a striped headdress on a golden throne. Only men in the picture, no paintings of people on the walls.
caption: משה ואהרן הלכו אל פרעה

en: Tired Hebrew slaves, bearded men in worn robes, bending down in a dry harvested field gathering dry straw stubble by hand into bundles, an Egyptian overseer in a white kilt shouting and pointing at an unfinished pile of bricks. Only men in the picture. Gentle, not scary.
caption: פרעה הכביד את העבודה: אין תבן!

en: In a grand Egyptian palace hall, a large green crocodile lying on the stone floor where a wooden staff was thrown, Aharon, a man with a grey beard, pointing at it calmly, Moshe, tall with a dark brown beard, beside him, Pharaoh on his golden throne leaning back surprised. Pharaoh is alone on his throne with no courtiers, servants or guards anywhere in the room. Only these three men in the picture,
caption: המטה של אהרן נהפך לתנין

en: The Nile river in Egypt with its water turned completely deep red, Egyptian men in white kilts standing on the bank holding empty clay jugs with surprised faces, palm trees and an Egyptian temple behind. Only men in the picture. Not scary, no blood splatter.
caption: המים ביאר נהפכו לדם

en: A funny scene inside an Egyptian house: dozens of cute green frogs jumping everywhere, on the bed, in the bread oven, on the table, in the cooking pot, an Egyptian man in a white kilt hopping on one foot in surprise. Only men in the picture, no paintings of people on the walls. Cheerful cartoon, not scary.
caption: צפרדעים קפצו בכל מקום

en: Egyptian men in white kilts scratching their heads and arms with funny annoyed faces, the dusty ground around them full of tiny little dots of bugs, an Egyptian palace in the background. Only men in the picture. Light-hearted cartoon, not disgusting.
caption: העפר נהפך לכנים

en: A dramatic sky over green Egyptian fields: big round icy white hailstones falling from dark clouds, and inside each hailstone a small glowing orange flame, a palm tree, no people. Beautiful and wondrous, not scary.
caption: ברד גדול, ואש בתוכו

en: Moshe, a tall man with a dark brown beard, standing outside the walls of an Egyptian city with his hands spread up in prayer, the dark storm clouds above him opening and the hail stopping in mid-air, bright sunshine breaking through, last hailstones melting on the ground.
caption: משה התפלל, והברד נעצר

en: A huge swarm of brown grasshoppers flying over Egyptian green fields and eating every leaf and plant, the trees becoming bare, Egyptian men in white kilts waving their arms. Only men in the picture. Cartoon, not scary.
caption: הארבה אכל את כל העשב

en: A split view of a village at night: on the left Egyptian houses in total thick black darkness, on the right simple Hebrew houses glowing with warm bright golden light from their windows and doorways, bearded men and boys inside the bright houses smiling.
caption: חשך במצרים, ואור בבתי ישראל

en: A Hebrew father with a dark beard and his two young sons choosing a pure white young lamb from a flock of sheep in front of their simple mud-brick house in Egypt, the father holding the lamb gently, the boys petting it.
caption: כל משפחה לקחה שה לקרבן פסח

en: A Hebrew man with a beard dipping a bunch of green hyssop plant in a small bowl and painting red stripes on the top beam and the two side posts of the wooden doorway of his mud-brick house, at evening.
caption: שמו דם על המשקוף ועל המזוזות

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons standing around a table at night, eating flat round matzah crackers and green bitter herbs, each holding a walking stick, belts tied around their robes and sandals on their feet, ready to travel, an oil lamp glowing.
caption: אכלו מצה ומרור, והמקל ביד

en: A huge happy crowd of Hebrew men and boys walking out of Egypt at dawn with sheep, cows and donkeys, each man carrying a bundle of dough wrapped in cloth on his shoulder, pyramids behind them, rising sun ahead. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: יצאו ממצרים עם הבצק על הכתף

en: A long caravan of Hebrew people with tents, donkeys and sheep walking through the desert following a tall bright white column of cloud in front of them, and on the far horizon in the evening sky a tall glowing column of fire lighting the way. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ה' הלך לפניהם בעמוד ענן ובעמוד אש

en: The sea split in two with tall high walls of blue water on both sides and a dry sandy path in the middle, Hebrew men and boys with sheep walking safely on the dry path, colorful fish visible inside the water walls, Moshe with a dark brown beard holding up his staff on the shore. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ה' קרע את ים סוף

en: Joyful Hebrew men and boys standing on the sandy seashore after crossing the sea, singing together with their hands raised up to the sky and big happy smiles, Moshe with a dark brown beard leading the song, the calm blue sea behind them. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: משה ובני ישראל שרו שירה לה'

en: Early morning in a desert camp of tents: the ground all around the tents covered with small round white flakes like tiny seeds glistening in the sunrise, bearded men and boys happily gathering them into baskets.
caption: המן ירד מן השמים

en: A Hebrew man with a beard and his little son happily carrying two baskets, each one full to the top with small round white flakes, toward their tent in the desert in the late afternoon, other baskets set aside, the sun getting low.
caption: ביום ששי לקחו מן כפול, לשבת

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, sitting on a stone on a hilltop with both arms raised high holding his staff, two bearded men standing on each side and supporting his tired arms, far below in the valley small soldiers with shields. No blood, no violence shown.
caption: משה הרים ידיו, וישראל נצחו את עמלק

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, warmly hugging Yitro, an old kind man with a long white beard and a walking stick, in front of a tent in the desert, Moshe's two young sons smiling beside them, a camel nearby.
caption: יתרו בא אל משה במדבר

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, sitting on a simple seat outside a tent and listening patiently, a long line of bearded men waiting to speak to him, the sun rising on one side of the sky and setting on the other.
caption: משה שפט את העם מבקר עד ערב

en: A huge peaceful camp of countless tents spread out in the desert at the foot of a tall rocky mountain, bearded men and boys standing together side by side looking up at the mountain with joy. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: חנו מול ההר כאיש אחד בלב אחד

en: Hebrew men and boys in a desert camp washing their clothes in big clay basins, clean white robes hanging to dry on ropes between the tents, everyone busy and excited, a tall mountain in the background.
caption: התכוננו לקבלת התורה וכבסו את בגדיהם

en: A tall rocky mountain covered with thick smoke and fire on its top, lightning flashing in heavy clouds, a long ram's horn shofar shape glowing in the clouds, many bearded men and boys standing at the foot of the mountain in awe. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ההר עשן, וקול השופר הלך וחזק

en: Two rounded stone tablets standing on the top of a mountain, shining with bright golden light, rays of light coming down from parting clouds, blank tablets with no writing. No people, nothing in the sky except light and clouds.
caption: ה' נתן לנו את עשרת הדברות

en: A kind Hebrew man with a beard in a nice robe handing a small bag of silver coins to a poor man in torn patched clothes, both smiling, in front of a simple house, the poor man's young son looking happy.
caption: מלוים כסף לעני

en: A Hebrew man with a beard leading a big brown ox by a rope back to its owner, a farmer with a beard who opens his arms in surprise and joy at the gate of his field.
caption: משיבים אבדה: שור שתעה

en: Two Hebrew men with beards working together to help a fallen donkey get up from the ground, lifting the heavy sacks off its back, on a dusty road.
caption: עוזרים לחמור שנפל תחת המשא

en: Hebrew men and boys walking together joyfully on a road up a green hill, carrying baskets of fruit and leading lambs, going up to a holy place on the hilltop, festival atmosphere. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: עולים לרגל שלש פעמים בשנה

en: A huge crowd of Hebrew men and boys at the foot of a mountain raising their right hands together with excited joyful faces, Moshe with a dark brown beard standing on a rock in front of them holding a scroll. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: בני ישראל אמרו: נעשה ונשמע!

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, climbing up a high rocky mountain and walking into a thick bright white cloud covering the top, his young helper with a short beard waiting below.
caption: משה עלה אל ההר בתוך הענן

en: Happy Hebrew men and boys in a desert camp bringing gifts and putting them on big piles: gold jewelry, silver bowls, colorful blue, purple and red wool, wooden beams and animal skins. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: כלם הביאו תרומה למשכן בלב שלם

en: A beautiful rectangular wooden chest completely covered with shiny gold, with a flat golden lid on top and two long golden carrying poles on its sides, standing on a desert floor with soft light. Nothing on top of the lid, no figures, no people.
caption: ארון הברית מצפה זהב

en: A golden table with two neat stacks of six golden-brown loaves of bread each, standing in a quiet tent-like room. No people.
caption: השלחן ועליו לחם הפנים

en: A tall seven-branched golden menorah lamp with decorated cups shaped like almond flowers, seven small flames burning on top, glowing warmly in a dim tent. No people.
caption: מנורת הזהב

en: Hebrew craftsmen with beards building a holy tent in the desert: standing up tall golden wooden boards side by side, and spreading big colorful woven curtains of blue, purple and red over them.
caption: יריעות וקרשים למשכן

en: A square outdoor altar covered with shiny copper, with a pointy horn at each of its four corners and a ramp leading up to it, a small fire burning on top, standing in a desert courtyard. No people.
caption: מזבח הנחשת

en: A Hebrew man with a beard crushing ripe green olives in a stone bowl and catching the clear golden pure oil drops in a small clay jug, olive trees around him.
caption: מביאים שמן זית זך למנורה

en: Bearded Hebrew craftsmen sitting in a workshop tent sewing beautiful priestly garments of blue, purple, red and gold threads, a long blue robe with little golden bells and pomegranates on its hem hanging up.
caption: תופרים בגדי כהנה לאהרן

en: Aharon, a man with a grey beard in beautiful priestly clothes, wearing on his chest a square golden breastplate with twelve shining colorful gemstones in four rows, close-up, smiling. No letters on the stones.
caption: החשן ובו שתים עשרה אבנים

en: Aharon, a man with a grey beard wearing a white turban, with a shining thin golden plate tied with a blue cord on his forehead, in beautiful priestly clothes, close-up, peaceful face. No letters on the plate.
caption: הציץ של זהב על המצח

en: Moshe, a tall man with a dark brown beard, pouring golden oil from a horn onto the head of his brother Aharon, a man with a grey beard in priestly clothes who bows his head, in front of a holy tent.
caption: משה משח את אהרן בשמן המשחה

en: A small square golden altar with four little horns on its corners, sweet fragrant smoke rising from it in soft curls, standing in front of a beautiful curtain inside a dim holy tent. No people.
caption: מזבח הקטרת

en: A line of Hebrew men with beards each dropping one small half silver coin into a big copper basin, Moshe with a dark brown beard watching, in a desert camp.
caption: כל אחד נתן מחצית השקל

en: Priests in white robes and white turbans washing their hands and feet from a large shiny copper basin with water flowing from its spouts, in a desert courtyard.
caption: הכהנים רוחצים ידים ורגלים מן הכיור

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons in white festive clothes sitting together at a Shabbat table inside a tent in the desert, two lit candles, two braided challah breads, a wine cup, the father blessing them, peaceful happy faces.
caption: ושמרו בני ישראל את השבת

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, standing on a mountain slope holding two stone tablets high above his head about to throw them down, sad face, far below in the valley a small golden calf statue on a stone base. No other people near the calf.
caption: משה ראה את העגל ושבר את הלחות

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, alone on the top of a mountain, kneeling and praying with all his heart, his hands spread out, a desert camp of tents far below.
caption: משה התפלל על בני ישראל

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, walking down a mountain holding two new stone tablets in his arms, his face shining with beams of bright light, Hebrew men and boys below looking up at him in wonder. No writing on the tablets.
caption: משה ירד עם לחות שניים, ופניו קורנות

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, standing on a large rock and speaking to a huge crowd of Hebrew men and boys gathered all together in a desert camp, everyone listening carefully. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: משה הקהיל את כל בני ישראל

en: A quiet peaceful Shabbat afternoon in a desert camp: a cold empty fire pit with no fire and a covered cooking pot beside a tent, a Hebrew father with a beard and his young son resting nearby and reading from a scroll, calm golden light.
caption: בשבת לא מבעירים אש

en: Smiling Hebrew men and boys lining up and joyfully giving gifts: gold bracelets and rings, silver, colorful wool, precious stones and wooden beams, putting them into big baskets in front of a tent. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: כלם הביאו נדבה בשמחה

en: A young craftsman with a short dark beard and an older craftsman with a grey beard teaching a group of eager young craftsmen how to carve wood and shape gold in a big workshop tent full of tools.
caption: בצלאל ואהליאב מלמדים את חכמי הלב

en: A mountain of gifts overflowing everywhere in front of a tent: gold, silver, wool, wood and jewels piled very high, and Moshe with a dark brown beard holding up his hand to say stop, smiling, while men still arrive carrying more gifts.

en: Bearded Hebrew men working at large wooden looms, weaving long beautiful curtains in blue, purple and red colors, the curtains spread out shining in a workshop tent. Only men in the picture.
caption: חכמי הלב אורגים את היריעות

en: Bearded men sitting at a long table counting piles of shiny gold coins and silver bars, using a balance scale, Moshe with a dark brown beard standing and watching.
caption: ספרו את הזהב ואת הכסף

caption: הביאו את כל חלקי המשכן אל משה

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, raising both hands to bless a group of happy craftsmen with beards standing before him, outdoors in the desert camp, finished rolled colorful curtains, golden boards and a copper basin around them. No golden chest, no statues, no winged figures.
caption: משה ראה שעשו כמו שה' צוה, וברך אותם

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, setting up a beautiful holy tent in the desert: standing up golden boards, and colorful curtains being raised over them, the structure almost finished.
caption: משה הקים את המשכן

en: Moshe, a man with a dark brown beard, inside a holy tent lighting the flames of a tall seven-branched golden menorah with a small oil lamp, fragrant smoke rising from a small golden altar beside it.
caption: משה הדליק את המנורה והקטיר קטרת

en: A big glowing white cloud resting on top of and covering a beautiful holy tent in the middle of a desert camp, soft light shining from it, Hebrew men and boys watching from their tents in wonder.
caption: הענן כסה את המשכן

en: Moshe, a tall man with a dark brown beard, standing in awe at the entrance of a beautiful holy tent made of colorful woven curtains in the desert, a soft glowing white cloud resting above the tent, warm light coming from inside. Nobody else in the picture.
caption: ה' קרא אל משה מאהל מועד

en: A Hebrew man with a beard leading a young brown calf by a rope to a priest in a white robe and white turban who waits beside a large square copper altar with a small fire, in a desert courtyard with curtain walls.
caption: מביאים קרבן עולה מן הבקר

en: A poor Hebrew man in simple patched clothes humbly holding two white doves in his hands, offering them to a kind smiling priest in a white robe and white turban, a copper altar behind them, warm gentle light.
caption: העני מביא שתי יונים, וה' אוהב את קרבנו

en: A priest in a white robe and white turban holding a golden tray with a mound of fine white flour, pouring golden olive oil over it from a small jug, a little pile of white frankincense on the side.
caption: מנחה של סלת ושמן

en: A priest in a white robe and white turban sprinkling white salt from a bowl onto an offering on a large copper altar, salt crystals sparkling in the sunlight, desert courtyard.
caption: על כל קרבן שמים מלח

en: A Hebrew man with a beard and a sorry, hopeful face bringing a small goat to a kind priest in a white robe and white turban, who puts a comforting hand on his shoulder, copper altar in the background.
caption: מי שטעה מביא קרבן ועושה תשובה

en: At sunrise, a priest in a white linen robe and white turban scooping a shovel of grey ashes from the top of a large copper altar into a pan, the morning sky pink and gold.
caption: הכהן מרים את הדשן בבקר

en: A priest in a white robe and white turban placing big logs of wood onto a strongly burning fire on top of a large copper altar at night, stars in the sky, the fire bright and steady.
caption: אש תמיד תוקד על המזבח

en: Aharon, a man with a grey beard in colorful priestly garments with a golden breastplate, holding a flat pan with golden-brown baked flat cakes, offering them at a copper altar.
caption: אהרן מקריב מנחה בכל יום

en: A happy Hebrew man with a beard carrying a big basket full of many different round breads and loaves to a priest in a white robe, his young son beside him smiling, giving thanks.
caption: מי שנצל מביא קרבן תודה עם לחמים

en: Moshe, a tall man with a dark brown beard, dressing his brother Aharon, a man with a grey beard, in a beautiful long blue robe, while Aharon's four grown sons in white robes and white turbans stand beside them, in front of a holy tent.
caption: משה מלביש את אהרן ובניו

en: Four young priests in white robes and white turbans sitting calmly together at the entrance of a holy tent made of colorful curtains, day and night shown with the sun and moon in the sky, peaceful faces.
caption: הכהנים ישבו שבעה ימים בפתח אהל מועד

en: Aharon, a man with a grey beard in colorful priestly garments with a golden breastplate, standing at a large copper altar with a young calf and a ram beside him, his sons in white helping, a big crowd of men watching from afar.
caption: ביום השמיני אהרן מקריב קרבנות

en: Aharon, a man with a grey beard in colorful priestly garments with a golden breastplate, standing on a step and raising both hands to bless a big happy crowd of Hebrew men and boys. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אהרן נשא את ידיו וברך את העם

en: A great bright column of golden fire coming down onto a large copper altar and burning up the offering, a big crowd of Hebrew men and boys shouting with joy and bowing down. Nothing in the sky except light. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: אש יצאה ואכלה את הקרבן, וכל העם שמחו

en: A young priest in a white robe and white turban politely refusing with his raised palm a cup of red wine offered to him, smiling, a holy tent behind him.
caption: כהן לא שותה יין לפני העבודה

en: A peaceful green pasture with a cow, a sheep, a goat and a deer chewing grass, a close-up showing their split hooves clearly on the ground. No people.
caption: בהמה טהורה מפריסה פרסה ומעלה גרה

en: Under the clear blue water, colorful fish with clear fins and shiny scales swimming among seaweed and stones, close-up so the fins and scales are easy to see. No people.
caption: דג טהור: יש לו סנפיר וקשקשת

en: A joyful celebration in a tent: a Hebrew father with a beard holding his tiny newborn baby boy wrapped in a white blanket on a pillow, bearded men around him smiling and clapping, a festive table with food. Only men in the picture.
caption: ברית מילה ביום השמיני

en: A Hebrew man with a beard looking with a worried face at a small round white spot on the back of his forearm, sitting outside his tent.
caption: כתם לבן על העור

en: A Hebrew man with a beard walking toward a priest in a white robe and white turban and showing him his arm with a small white spot, the priest looking carefully.
caption: הולכים להראות את הנגע לכהן

en: A Hebrew man with a beard sitting alone and patiently in front of a small separate tent, counting seven pebbles in a row on the ground in front of him, calm face.
caption: מחכים שבעה ימים

en: A priest in a white robe and white turban smiling and joyfully raising his hand, telling a Hebrew man with a beard that he is clean; the man is jumping with happiness, his arm clear and healthy.
caption: הכהן אומר: טהור!

en: A woolen robe hanging on a line with a small greenish-red stain on it, a priest in a white robe and white turban examining it carefully.
caption: נגע בבגד

en: A kind priest in a white robe and white turban walking out of a camp of tents into the open desert toward a lonely man sitting by a small tent far away.
caption: הכהן יוצא אל מחוץ למחנה

en: On a wooden table in the desert: two small birds in a little cage, a piece of cedar wood, a red woolen thread, and a bunch of green hyssop leaves. No people.
caption: שתי צפרים, עץ ארז, שני תולעת ואזוב

en: A small bird flying happily away into a wide open blue sky over a green field, free, a priest in a white robe watching it from below with open hands.
caption: צפור אחת עפה לחפשי

en: A Hebrew man with a short-shaved face washing his clothes in a clay basin of clean water beside a stream, happy, clean white robes drying on a bush.
caption: המטהר מתגלח ומכבס את בגדיו

en: A happy Hebrew man leading two white lambs toward a holy tent made of colorful curtains, a priest in a white robe and white turban waiting to greet him, morning light.
caption: ביום השמיני מביא כבשים לקרבן

en: Two Hebrew workers with beards carefully pulling out a few stones that have greenish-red spots from the wall of a stone house, a priest in a white robe and white turban pointing at the spots.
caption: נגע בבית: מוציאים אבנים מהקיר

en: The high priest, a man with a grey beard, wearing only simple pure white linen garments and a white turban, standing reverently at the entrance of a holy tent, glowing soft light.
caption: ביום כפור הכהן הגדול לובש בגדי לבן

en: The high priest, a man with a grey beard in white linen garments, standing between two identical brown goats and drawing two small golden tablets out of a wooden box, other priests in white watching.
caption: גורל על שני שעירים

en: The high priest, a man with a grey beard in white linen garments, walking slowly through a parted curtain into a dim inner room, holding a golden pan of glowing coals and a ladle of incense, fragrant smoke curling up.
caption: הכהן הגדול נכנס עם הקטרת

en: A Hebrew man with a beard leading a brown goat by a rope far into an empty rocky desert toward distant cliffs, the camp far behind.
caption: השעיר נשלח למדבר

en: Hebrew men and boys dressed all in white standing together and praying with deep feeling, some with eyes closed, in a desert camp at sunset, a soft glow over them. Only men and boys in the picture.
caption: ביום כפור מבקשים סליחה ונטהרים

en: A happy Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons joyfully doing mitzvot together: putting up a mezuzah case on a doorpost, learning from a scroll, and giving bread to a poor man, bright sunny day.
caption: וחי בהם: חיים עם המצוות בשמחה

en: A boy about eight years old respectfully bringing a cup of water and a plate of bread to his tired father, a man with a beard sitting on a chair at home, the father smiling warmly. Only the boy and his father in the picture.
caption: מכבדים את אבא ואת אמא

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard harvesting a golden wheat field with a sickle but leaving the corner of the field uncut, while a poor man with a basket happily gathers from that corner.
caption: משאירים פאה לעני

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard handing silver coins to a tired worker holding a hoe at sunset, both smiling, the field behind them.
caption: משלמים לפועל באותו יום

en: A kind Hebrew boy removing a big stone from a path in front of an old blind man with a walking stick who is walking slowly, the boy holding the man's arm gently.
caption: לא שמים מכשול לפני עור

en: Two Hebrew boys about eight years old sharing their bread and fruit with each other and hugging as friends, sitting under a tree, happy faces.
caption: ואהבת לרעך כמוך

en: A young Hebrew man with a short beard standing up from his seat with respect as an old man with a long white beard and a walking stick enters the room, others standing too.
caption: קמים מפני זקן

en: A peaceful Shabbat table at evening in a stone house: two lit candles, two braided challah breads under a cover, a silver cup of wine, a father with a beard and his sons in festive white clothes singing together.
caption: שבת: יום מנוחה לה'

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons sitting at a festive table eating round flat matzah, a plate of bitter herbs, cups of wine, at night, lamp light.
caption: בפסח אוכלים מצות

en: A Hebrew farmer with a beard proudly cutting the first bundle of golden barley in a field and carrying it in his arms to a priest in a white robe and white turban, spring morning.
caption: מביאים את העמר

en: A priest in a white robe and white turban lifting up two big golden loaves of bread, wheat fields and green hills in the background, early summer.
caption: שבועות: שתי הלחם

en: A Hebrew man with a beard wrapped in a white prayer shawl blowing a long curved ram's horn shofar, men and boys listening around him, autumn morning.
caption: ראש השנה: תוקעים בשופר

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his young sons sitting happily inside a sukkah hut with a roof of green branches, the father holding a palm branch, a citron, myrtle and willow branches, colorful decorations.
caption: סכות: יושבים בסכה ולוקחים ארבעה מינים

en: An open orchard with no fence, the gate wide open, many different Hebrew men and boys and also some deer and birds happily picking and eating ripe figs, grapes and pomegranates.
caption: כלם אוכלים מפרות השמטה

en: A Hebrew man with a beard standing on a hilltop blowing a long ram's horn shofar, villages and fields below, people looking up joyfully.
caption: יובל: תוקעים בשופר

en: Happy Hebrew men walking out through an open wooden gate toward their own homes and fields, waving, a farmer welcoming one of them back to his field.
caption: העבדים יוצאים לחפשי

en: A Hebrew merchant with a beard at a market stall weighing grain honestly on a balance scale for a customer, both smiling, baskets of fruit and grain around.
caption: מוכרים בישר

en: A kind Hebrew man with a beard holding the hand of a poor man and helping him stand up, giving him a bag of grain and a small sack of coins, a simple village street.
caption: מחזיקים ביד העני

en: Hebrew men and boys sitting together under a big tree learning from scrolls with joy and excitement, a teacher with a white beard pointing in a scroll, sunny day.
caption: אם בחקתי תלכו: לומדים תורה

en: Gentle rain falling from grey clouds onto green fields and young wheat sprouts, a Hebrew farmer with a beard smiling and looking up with open arms, a rainbow beginning to appear.
caption: ה' נותן גשמים בעתם

en: An orchard full of trees heavy with ripe fruit: pomegranates, figs, grapes, olives and dates, Hebrew boys climbing ladders and filling baskets happily.
caption: העצים מלאים פרות

en: A Hebrew father with a beard and his sons around a table with plenty of fresh bread loaves, everyone eating happily and satisfied, a full granary visible through the window.
caption: אוכלים לחם לשבע

en: A peaceful village at night under the stars and moon, Hebrew men and boys sleeping calmly on rooftops, sheep resting quietly in a pen, a wolf far away walking off. Calm and safe.
caption: שלום בארץ: ישנים בלי פחד

en: A beautiful holy tent glowing with soft light in the very center of a big camp of tents, happy Hebrew families of men and boys around it, a gentle white cloud above it.
caption: ונתתי משכני בתוככם
